statute: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Definition, Scope and Prohibitions for Ayurveda Aahar
content:
'Ayurveda Aahar' means food prepared in accordance with the recipes or ingredients or processes described in the authoritative books of Ayurveda listed in Schedule A, but shall not include Ayurvedic drugs or proprietary Ayurvedic medicines.

Key Legal Boundaries:
1. Prohibited Additions: Must NOT contain synthetic vitamins, minerals, or amino acids. Only natural ingredients conforming to authoritative texts can be included.
2. Medicinal Claim Ban: Ayurveda Aahar labels must NOT make disease treatment, prevention, or curative claims. May only claim health promotion, physiological wellness, or traditional dietary benefits.
3. Mandatory Logo: Must display the dedicated FSSAI 'Ayurveda Aahar' green/brown logo.
4. IP Strategy: Not patentable as a therapeutic agent (Sec 3(p) & 3(i)). Protection is primarily via Trade Marks, trade dress, and proprietary culinary processes.
